授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Biomaterial Science I takes place in the spring quarter.
Room: W5-228
Note on Course Enrollment:
This course, Biomaterial Science I, is closely related to Biomaterial Science II, which is offered in the following semester. Since the content of both courses is designed to be continuous and complementary, students are strongly encouraged to enroll in both courses to gain a comprehensive understanding of the subject.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Lecture attendance is mandatory.
The topic for each report will be provided in each lecture.
Full attendance and submission of 7 reports are required to get class credit.
